root_cause: Two independent every-minute runtime maintenance cron owners opened separate database sessions while the canonical commercial heartbeat also started every five minutes. Under database pressure pg_cron reported repeated job startup timeouts, including heartbeat job 154, and PostgREST schema-cache loads hit statement timeouts.
prevention: Replace the two minute-level cron owners with one advisory-lock-protected runtime maintenance tick. The execution-resilience watchdog still runs every minute; reconciliation runs in the same session except on commercial heartbeat minutes.
